items.title: Actual Gaussian exponential normalized bias

source.anchor: S4.Thmtheorem5.p2.1/Ex17; A3.SS3.p9-p11/Ex150-159; standing S4 fixed-spectrum family. The private numerical zero-threshold application has no source Anchor.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling.
source.scope: Actual normalized cosine-quadratic mean under the diagonal inverse-precision Gaussian, with the explicit source gap.

items.statement: For the actual inverse-precision Gaussian, the absolute cosine-quadratic mean divided by the squared-norm mean has the following exponential bounds. (1-e^{-4})e^{-3n/\sqrt\kappa}\le\frac{|b|}{M}\le e^{-2n/\sqrt\kappa},\qquad M>0,\quad(-1)^n b>0. Fix \(d\in\mathbb N\), \(d\ge2\), \(\kappa\in\mathbb R\), \(\kappa\ge2\), and \(n\in\mathbb N\) with \(1\le n<d\). Assume the source gap \(d-n\ge\sqrt\kappa\). This subtraction is in the reals after casting the natural indices. Set \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+((\kappa-1)/2)\cos\theta_i\), and \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\). Lean uses \(i\in\mathrm{Fin}\,d\) and \((i.\mathrm{val}+1/2)\pi/d\). Let \(U\sim N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\) in standard real Euclidean space, \(Q(x)=\sum_i\cos(n\theta_i)x_i^2\), \(M=\mathbb E\|U\|^2\), and \(b=\mathbb E Q(U)\). The Gaussian matrix argument is covariance; \(\Lambda\) is precision. The source gap is an explicit hypothesis. The exact means, positivity, logarithmic integral estimates, denominator guards and exponential comparisons are internal proof dependencies, with no extra moment, logarithm, variance or law certificate hypothesis.
